reviews.comment: This class is manageable if you have friends who want to actually *get* the content. If you have time, use chat and just study every term on the overview... if you can explain pretty much everything from that, you've got it. Great guy, but his lectures were just him reading his pre-written notes back to you. Lots of extra credit though. Solid prof

Dr. Wickersham is an amazing professor, and you can tell he really cares about what he does. This class is pretty difficult, and there is a lot of information to memorize but it is manageable if you stay on top of studying. I highly recommend going to lecture because he does a lot of random EC assignments in class, and the extra points help a lot.
Love him! Lots of EC

he teaches by taking notes in class:gives you enough time to write down information & makes sure you understand what you're writing. encourages questions during lecture. exams are tough, but doable. FRQ and MCQ. MCQ are select all that apply, and if u pick one wrong the whole question is wrong, but if you pick too few you get partial credit.

My favorite professor I've had. He wants you to do well and clearly gives you exactly what you need to know for the exams. He is a great professor to get to know, if you're considering taking the honors section, do it! The content of the class is hard, but he doesn't intentionally make it harder. Take pictures of his notes and study them!

I loved this professor!!! You can tell he enjoys teaching. His class is very challenging but he is so willing to help and answer any questions you have. Go to the reviews because they do really help. Study every day and memorize all of the drawings to be successful. Make it a point to meet this professor and talk to him you will not regret it.

He is a great prof, however his exams are extremely hard. You need to fully understand the info. Lots of trick questions, if you think "no way he can make that into a trick question" think again. He's very sweet. Pop quizes are extra credit and is the sole reason why I got a B so for your own sake, go to class.

I loved this class! Dr. Wickersham's exams can be challenging, but he genuinely teaches really well (in my opinion). I would recommend staying on top of your studies in this class, because everything builds upon itself, but his lectures were super helpful!

one of the best professors ive had at this school. exams are insanely hard, but he truly cares about his students if u put in the time and effort to succeed. he never belittles people for asking questions and is very understanding about life outside school. lots of extra credit quizzes too so show up to class!

One of the best professors I have ever had. Class is content heavy so you need to study, but his exams follow a similar format. Anything he writes in class, write it down. Gives a lot of extra credit pop quizzes, so show up to class to get free points. Uses analogies and visual representations a lot, super nice and overall a very good professor.

HW is an easy participation grade. Expect to recreate a partial/entire drawing for every single exam, so PRACTICE! Short answer portion is much easier than multiple choice. MC has tricky questions so read very carefully. Extra credit can be the difference between an A and B, so go to class and get those free points. He's a super sweet prof though!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Wickersham is a fantastic professor! The class is hard, but he explains things clearly and gives you everything you need to succeed—extra credit if you show up, approachable, and TRULY cares. You'll learn a lot if you put in the work. Make sure you know your drawings well as they help so much on exams! Tough but rewarding. I LOVED THIS CLASS!!

Dr. Wickersham handwrites his notes, so be prepared to write a lot! It wasn't bad but I was surprised. He makes good jokes and cares about his student's success beyond 303, and I always looked forward to his class. His test questions can be tricky at times, but if you understand the material they are easy to break down and pretty straightforward.

The class itself is hard but he is a great professor. He's very smart and kind and ready to help. I recommend sitting towards the bottom to hear better. A passing grade is 100% possible if you study during the week.

Dr. Wickersham was a great professor and explained the material in a way that I haven't seen before. The class is quite difficult and the material is hard to understand, but you need to have a deep understanding of the material to truly succeed. This class teaches you more about how you think than nutrition itself. 10/10, nonetheless! STUDY!!!!!!!!

The professor is really passionate about the subject and works with students but this class IS NOT EASY. Class consists of you copying his notes which make no sense. The homework assignments are select all that apply with like 75 options. Exams are half open ended/ half multiple choice. The multiple choice questions will make you feel so dumb.

If you're taking this class, trap yourself down to whatever chair you're sitting on cause this is going to be a rough ride. He doesn't record his lectures. On his tests he gives you a ton of blanks then claims later that you should have kept a majority of them blank. The multiple choice questions are designed to trick you and are unfair.

Dr. Wickersham is so very passionate about the content he teaches, and truly wants you to succeed in his class and life. His exams can be tricky, but studying a couple days before was plenty. He does extra credit quizzes in class towards the end of the semester so GO TO CLASS! Go to his office hours and go out of your way to get to know him.

A really entertaining/kind prof who teaches well. content is not hard but tests r tricky. u must truly grasp what's going on + pay attention to wording of questions. He offers extra credit pop quizzes during lectures to boost grades. MUST GO TO LECTURE. Memorize diagrams to boost test grade. Homeworks r kinda hard. know content well for mc part.

Wickersham is an amazing professor and truly cares about his students. Exams were rough if you didn't study or memorize the drawings (exams are mc and free response and points are split 50/50). Make sure to go to class or you won't pass! Be prepared to study! I never studied harder for a class before but it paid off!

Dr. Wickersham is such an amazing professor. He genuinely cares about his students and wants to see them succeed. Attendance is not mandatory but I highly recommend showing up to every class because there are no lecture slides posted. He lectures at a good pace and gives a few extra credit quizzes per exam.

His tests are hard, but he has a lot of pop quizzes that are extra credit. He cares a lot about his students and makes himself very available outside of class. He also answers all questions without judgment and is very knowledgeable in the subject as well as conveying the information in an understandable way.

Great prof. You can't get by without studying a bunch, but he offers a lot of extra credit, office hours for reviewing exams and quizzes, etc. You'll truly understand the subject front and back after taking his class. He really cares for his students and is always accessible

This is the best professor I have ever had! I wish I could take the class again. The exams are difficult being 50/50 multiple choice and free response. However, he give a ton of extra credit in class so I reccomend going to all lectures. He's great at teaching and handwrites his notes in class making it really easy to understand.

I THOROUGHLY enjoyed this class. Wickersham is an amazing professor and I don't know how I'm going to go back to mediocre ones. Show up to class for extra credit and don't give up on your grade. I failed the first exam + mini exam in the bottom quartile and still made an A by making the highest grade on the final. He genuinely cares about everyone.

Wickersham had A LOT material in his lectures so go to class, study for the exams early. Honestly thought the lecture was easier than the lab though. Study hard for the lab quizzes and study well for the exams. The tests can be difficult because a lot of info, but fair. Sometimes hard to keep up with lecture, but the powerpoints he gives are good.

Dr. Wickersham is a great professor. His exams are difficult as they require you to understand the material on a deeper level, but study the notes and understand the diagrams and you should be fine. He does give extra credit pop quizzes which helped with points, and his lectures are fun. He truly cares about his students and wants you to succeed!

This prof was great and I loved how he was passionate about teaching. I also liked that he would provide extra credit by just going to class and completing really easy quizzes. One complaint I would have would be that his exams were tricky because they were very detailed. He tries to help you out in office hours though and so do the TAs.

Dr. Wickersham is amazing! He's genuinely such a nice person who cares deeply about his students. If you are sick and need the notes from class or to reschedule a test, he is willing to work with you. Wickersham once stopped class and had a heart to heart conversation with the entire class. He jokes around quite often as well and is pretty cool!

Dr. Wickersham is by far the best professor I have had at TAMU. He is kind, understanding, and willing to help you no matter what. he is very accommodating. Yes his exams are hard but study well and you'll be fine. If you are struggling go to his office hours he will help you. He also does extra credit quizzes every week.

Dr. Wickersham's class is very difficult. But he des an amazing job of making lectures interesting and being very clear about paper deadlines and exam dates. Attendance is not mandatory but if you don't go you will not pass. Take veryyyy good notes.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very cool professor. Knows his stuff. He writes his lectures during class, must pay attention. Recording lectures helped because not everything he says gets written down. Easy extra credit quizzes that boost your grade a lot. Memorize drawings!!! 50% of exams is drawing what he teaches. Very smart and caring. Intimidating but funny. learned a lot.

Dr. Wickersham is the best! He lectures by taking notes on paper with the class. Study ALL of your notes and know how to draw EVERY diagram he draws. Go to class because he gives extra credit quizzes for attending (very easy). There is a lot of material on the exams so be prepared to know it all. He is so nice and really funny. Awesome professor!

Although attendance isn't mandatory, you must attend class and actively take lots of notes as his lectures make up his exam. This class is very difficult and requires a LOT of time to study and review materials. Dr. Wickersham and his TAs are very helpful outside of class.

Very good lecturer. Material is presented in a way that encourages understanding and systems thinking instead of run-off-the-mill memorization. Strives to adapt teaching style to the needs of the students and judges his own success as a lecturer by student success on exams. Completing reading before class is helpful but not necessary.

BEST CLASS AT A&M! SO interesting+I learned SO much, at end of the yr it comes together+u understand each animal nutr. as whole. Pop quizzes=lots of extra credit = GO TO CLASS. Pay attention+study outside class, lectures are best format to understand the material. Think of it as a discussion - go to office hrs and ask ?s, it becomes even clearer.

Attendance matters! Random "pop quizzes" that add up and give bonus points at the end of the semester. Lectures consist of him writing down notes, which are projected onto the screen. Notes are not posted online, so skipping is not advised. Vocab and an understanding of what happens and why are crucial for doing well on tests.

Mr Wickersham is a great teacher. His lectures are interesting and sometimes confusing, but you can ask questions. Go to office hours when need, shows that you are interested. Study the drawings that you make when studying the test. This was an interesting and chill class but difficult. Reading not needed but does help.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: So many people say that Dr. Wickersham's nutrition is the most difficult ANSC class to take at A&M, and while it requires an investment of time, it is necessary to prep you for Feeds. I liked that rather than give a crazy amount of material, he gives you bite sized chunks and forces you to really understand the process of nutrition.

I made an A in this class but I studied very hard. Will ask questions on tests that are still very hard to answer with the notes right in front of you when you go back and look at your graded test. You need to understand every topic in-depth because they build on each other. This is by far the hardest class I have taken at A&M.

Dr.Wickersham clearly loves the material he teaches and cares about his students. Lectures are interesting and he writes down all the notes with you. ALWAYS go to class, he will have surprise extra credit, and you will not do well if you skip. Go to class and review the material often and you'll do great.

PLEASE TAKE HIM!! This guy is probably the best professor I've ever had here. Offers lots of extra credit and his lectures are basically him writing the notes with you. However, the tests are very tricky and studying for them involves lots of memorization and "out of the box" thinking. It's a lot but it's doable, just put the time in to study

Dr. Wickersham is such a cool dude. He offers extra credit sometimes in class that's worth 1 ENTIRE POINT OF YOUR GRADE EACH. If you went to every class you could make like an 82 and still get an A. However, don't be tricked this class is hard. His tests can be difficult and you *have* to memorize all of his drawings.

Exams were very tricky but lectures were easy to follow. Peer reviewed papers and quizzes helped boost grade. A lot of drawings and diagrams so bring some colored pens. Great professor, he really cares about his students.

Nutrition is a lot of information, but Dr. Wickersham makes everything super straightforward. He draws diagrams and writes notes at a reasonable pace, you write them down, and that's what's on the test. He also tells stories and makes jokes so it's not boring.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Wickersham is one of those professors who make you work for your grade but also REALLY cares about you. If you try and go to his office hours you will make the grade you want. I honestly didn't deserve the grade I got because I really struggled in his class, but because of his help I got an A.

He gives an insane amount of extra credit, so make sure you don't miss a single class!! The most important thing is to understand his drawings for the exams. Reading the textbook didn't really help me for the first exam so I stopped doing that.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Wickersham was one of my favorite profs this semester. He truly cares about students and it shows. He made 9am classes enjoyable. This class is difficult if you didnt grow up on a farm and you need to put in hard work. You cant just memorize content but his questions make sure you understand material. Attendance quizzes, papers, and 5 exams.

Amazing professor, person & lecturer. But, this class is terribly difficult. Averages for tests are 70% usually. Papers are easy if you take your time to meet the objectives. The exams have trick questions, provide extremely similar answer choices ("as that's how it would be in real life") & all ?'s answer choices are like A: 1 B: 2 C: A&B D: none
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The tests are actually impossible if you don't understand the material through and through. He teaches in lecture but expects you to understand another level practically on your own. He even said once that some of his favorite students have taken this class MULTIPLE times so there's that. I'd say take another prof but that's not an option.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Very difficult professor and class, he is a very nice person and caring. The test our extremely difficult. I would spend any way from 15-20 hours plus working on each open note test and still couldn't manage to make a 50. Each lecture video is deleted before the test so you only have your notes to refer back to which still isn't good enough.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: There was a test or essay due nearly every single week. Essays were fine, tests were very difficult and not about the information given to us. Does not provide lecture power points and only leaves up lecture videos for a week. Nice guy, bad class.

Dr. Wickersham is a wonderful professor! He cares about his students and is very understanding. He extended our exams and papers after the winter storm. He is very passionate about this class and his lectures are very interesting and easy to follow. Would recommend!

I love this professor!!! He was so kind and caring toward our class especially during COVID. He teaches well and thinks about the well-being of his students. This class is is a difficult class to take but it's achievable if you work for it!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Wickersham is by far the best prof I've ever had. He is a great lecturer and genuinely cares about all of his students. The class itself is definitely difficult, but Dr. Wickersham is very accessible and gives many extra credit opportunities. This class is about deeper understanding, not just simply memorization, so study and go to class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Wickersham is known for being a really good guy and a really good prof. It's true, he's an amazing person and seems to really care about his students. Since moving online, his tests are impossible. I feel as if I spend hours to days on it (no timer) and can barely get full credit on vaguely worded questions. Unfair grading and unfair expectations

Dr. Wickersham is a great prof, but overall difficult class. Due to COVID, the class is fully online and he gives ample time to complete assignments, quizzes, & tests, although he makes you think during them. Tests & quizzes typically have questions that make you pick one or some of 25ish answer choices, so not easy stuff. Gives extra credit!

A really solid guy who presents his class with interesting material in a logical and concise way. His tests are ultra specific and he will find any excuse to dock points from free response questions but will always give you reasoning behind his choices.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved his lectures! The material is hard, and you HAVE to study!! Go over notes a few times a week and pay attention in lectures. Although attendance is not mandatory, you need to go to class! His lectures were really interesting and was easy to make connections. There is a lot of material! His tests are the hardest part of the class.

Dr. Wickersham is a great professor. The material is tough and tricky. You have to know what's happening in the drawings and make sure you don't skip class or else you will be lost. Record lecture. Tests aren't straight questions from lecture, he makes you think about how everything works together. Assignments & extra credit boost grade so do them!
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Wickersham is a great professor. His class is tough, but he is understanding and willing to help students that are struggling. The textbook is optional, but I found it to be very helpful for understanding topics. He offers a ridiculous amount of extra credit, so take every opportunity! Don't miss class, or you will be behind!

He hand writes all of his notes so going to class is helpful. He is in the class groupme and will answer any questions usually at any time (especially before an exam). He cares about his students and the information. The drawings are important since there is a short answer portion of the exams. It is a comparing course so you must know differences.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Dr. Wickersham was one of the best professors I have taken at TAMU. Although his tests are pretty hard, he prepares you well for them. His lectures are so easy since he writes notes with you as he talks about the material. I would 10/10 recommend. AND HE GIVES LOTS OF EXTRA CREDIT SO DON'T SKIP CLASS.

Dr. Wickersham is a great professor. Honestly though, his tests were impossible. I would know the info like the back of my hand and STILL would do poorly bc they were so tricky. I would take him again but only bc I truly learned so much from him and he is a great guy. Lowkey feel like I deserved an A, but I'll let it slide bc I loved the class.

Great guy, sincerely cares about his students. Papers 100% peer graded. Content depends heavily on drawings done in class. Book & class outline unused. Significant extra credit for in class pop quizzes & out of class dissections. TAs put incorrect info on exam reviews multiple times. Test Qs worded tricky.

GO TO CLASS. Although it's non-mandatory, he has extra credit quizzes all the time which can really help you grade out if you're struggling. Very approachable guy both in class and outside class. His exams are tough but doable if you can put in the work. Go to the SI sessions, practice the diagrams multiple times and take notes. Textbook isn't used
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Wickersham is a great professor! He is very respectable and cares very much about his students. His tests are somewhat difficult, so make sure that you study hard and never second guess yourself. The writing assignments are very helpful to get a good grade, so do your best on them.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: This class is hard, but if you go to class& take organized notes you will pass! The test are a bit tricky (answer choice D is a combination of choice A&B,etc). Read your notes and go over the drawings at the same time, this helped a lot!!4tests,final,and 5 writing assignments that boost your grade so DO GOOD IN THOSE. Quizzes are extra credit.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Skip this class often, you will get a bad grade. All the notes are handwritten and will never post the notes. At least once a week he will give a quiz, these are completely EXTRA CREDIT so go to class! Test are very hard, everything he covers you must know in depth. Good guy, GREAT PROF! Stay on-top of the class and you will be fine! go to class!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. W is amazing. His tests are no joke you MUST know your stuff and you must know your differences. The drawings of the pigs/cows/horses are not necessary to know for the exam, but they help so much if you create a story in your head. This class taught me how to be successful in other classes because of how hard I have to study here. Amazing prof
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He's a great professor who gave really great notes. He seemed like he actually cared about his students and was very available outside of class. He gave so much extra credit and 30% of the final is take home drawings he gives to you throughout the semester. He's just an amazing prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Wickersham is an amazing teacher who really cares about his students. He gives lots of extra credit just for going to class. His tests are difficult and he doesnt curve at the end of the semester but he does a great job teaching this subject.

Wickersham is easily the best professor I have ever had. He actually cares about his students and their success. His exams are VERY difficult so study A LOT. He does offer a lot of extra credit so be sure to attend class. His lecture style is a little different but I think it helps. If you put in the work, you will learn a lot in this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Wickersham is a great professor. The class however is not easy at all. You need to go to class for extra credit and to get the notes. No notes are online. You need to study hard for the tests. They are tricky and all about comparisons, so know your stuff. Great class though, if you need ANYTHING, Dr. Wickersham will help you out.

Dr. Wickersham is an amazing and funny professor, so his lectures aren't dry. Yeah, the class is difficult, but its an upper-level course. If you take organized notes, seek help when needed, and study ahead of time, the class is doable. Drawings you do in class really help understand the material. I learned a lot and really enjoyed the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Really hard. Nice guy but way too much effort for the exams since they are worth so much. Make sure you study up.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Ridiculous grader. Had an 88 whole semester but fails you with the final.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Wickersham is one of the best professors I've had in my time at TAMU. He's an awesome guy and is super entertaining in class. He makes the material very easy to understand and gives plenty of room for questions. Don't let his awesome personality fool you, his tests are tricky and make you second guess yourself. Make sure you're in class!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Wickersham is by far my favorite professor at Texas A&M. He is caring, funny, and very knowledgeable. He makes you work for your grades when it comes to exams, but if you study hard, you can do well. His lecture style is what makes the class doable. The world would be a better place if every professor lectured like he does.

Dr. Wickersham is by far one of the most well-versed in his profession professors I have ever had. His test actually test your understanding of the relationship between things rather than regurgitating random vocabulary. Also very willing to explain things and work with you.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Class is very difficult. Be prepared to study hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Wickersham is one of the nicest professors I have had in college. I enjoyed every day of his class. Do not skip because he gives a ton of attendance quizzes that will save your grade. He never curves, but utilize his office hours because he is very helpful. Definitely one of the smartest profs I have had, and that shows when he writes the tests
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great professor! Respected by all of the students. Participate in class and the material won't be too hard to understand! He is fair in grading and offers extra credit randomly through out the semester - so be in class! (the extra credit is what saved me!)
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great professor but his tests are tricky.  You can tell he really loves what he's talking about. Definitely go to office hours! It saved my grade!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: GREAT. I've heard good things about him from students who took courses other than Nutrition. Participate & ask questions even if it is an early class b/c lectures are where test material is pulled from. He's able to hold class's attention. Small class. Test is free response. Very fair grader. I learned lots. Textbook: good resource, not mandatory
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Wickersham came in the middle of the semester to teach ANSC 303 and he made it an easy transition for us. You need to go to class and listen because there isn't a textbook, but his lectures are entertaining (at least for me). He's willing to work with you on any missed test/quiz as long as he is aware of your situation.

I took Wickersham for 303 honors. He is a very engaging lecturer and truly wants you to learn and be successful. Tests are tough and free response but he curves and offers some extra credit. In contrast to what some people say he is very nice and willing to help. Honors even has a fun field trip too. Almost everyone in my class received As.
Tough
